notes.title: SOTANO Escape Room Adventure now on Mac
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41532373/2a1d84778a690183d009f9556229bba0afb42e16.png[/img]

[b]Sotano the escape room adventure is now available on macOS for the first time.
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41532373/7b5565e4422199bcab3bb3fb6f98acaa631f6998.png[/img]

Now escape room puzzle fans can enjoy the adventure on the [b]Mac[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41532373/8b7e9ebd675dbbe5b352acb6891ba748dce1040e.png[/img]

The release includes all the latest fixes and is launched along side the [b]Windows[/b] updated version which includes lots of fixes and improvements!

notes.title: Minor renovations of Escape Room Adventure Sotano complete.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41532373/d4ea596c93ec448a454767513f4eb709e59c7d8d.png[/img]

Happy 2022! I hope you have had a fantastic start to the year.

Sotano Version 1.0.5 - This is a general maintenance release. A few minor improvements to performance have been tweaked and a few minor bugs squashed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41532373/c5dbd4553c91980e7e76641e7aa1069daa2b0a99.png[/img]

If you haven’t already given Sotano a try yourself to see if you can solve the mystery and embark an escape room experience then now would be a great time to try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41532373/7b5565e4422199bcab3bb3fb6f98acaa631f6998.png[/img]
